'''Perk''' are passive abilities that provide bonuses to various activities. 

[[Keeper]] can acquire perks by purchasing them from the [[Inspirations#Talent tree|Talent Tree]] using Inspiration Points, with no limit on the number of perks he can obtain. [[Zombies]] acquire their perks using {{Tech|Red}}{{Tech|Green}}{{Tech|Blue}}, with the number of perks they can obtain limited by their {{Skull|Red}}.
